Criterion: All four posterior electrodes remained FDR-significant
Interpretation: Full posterior cluster survived FDR correction in most leave-one-subject-out folds.

Criterion: At least three of the four remained significant
Interpretation: Near-complete posterior localization survived FDR correction in nearly all folds.

Criterion: At least one posterior electrode remained FDR-significant
Interpretation: Posterior localization was retained in every leave-one-subject-out fold.

Criterion: Uncorrected group effects were present at each posterior electrode
Interpretation: Electrode-level uncorrected group effects did not depend on any single participant.
